 Job Description: 
 Parsons is searching for a professional to support development, integration, testing, and ongoing execution of in-house machine learning research on multi-agent reinforcement learning. 
 
 What You'll Be Doing : 
 This work will include conducting experiments on the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of deployed machine learning (ML) solutions. 
 Formulating and testing hypotheses via implementing compute-efficient AI/ML training methods, applying statistics, and performing data analysis 
 
 What Required Skills You'll Bring: 
 Required: B.S. in Computer Science or Engineering and 5+ years of post-degree machine learning experience, or  M.S. in Computer Science or Engineering and 2+ years of experience, or Ph.D. in relevant field 
 High proficiency in Python with a strong background in writing modular, testable, and maintainable codebases 
 Framework fluency with data science tools and libraries (NumPy, Pandas, etc) and at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow) 
 Familiarity with virtual environment tools such as Conda/uv/Poetry, or Docker containerization 
 Experience with Git and software development best practices, and working within Linux systems 
 The ability to work both individually and in a multi-team development project 
 Communicate methods and findings through publication manuscripts 
 U.S. Citizenship is required 
 Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance 
 
 Preferred Skills: 
 Experience with reinforcement learning or multi-agent systems 
 Experience running experiments on HPC or cloud systems, and tracking results for later analysis between machines (Trackio / Weights & Biases / Tensorboard with neat file management)  
 
 Security Clearance Requirement: 
None
